notes: The publisher-URL mapping: one row per attested canonical landing page.
Every entry cites its source; the example row is re-parsed and the
rendered canonical URL is asserted against `example.url` by the
URL pattern cannot be attested from the publisher's own site or a
documented deep-link scheme stays out of this table.
DOI mappings land per ported flavor, attested patterns only; the
IEEE/ISO/IEC DOI patterns wait for those flavors' pubid-rs port.

entries.source: ISO 26324 / the DOI Handbook handle resolution: https://doi.org/10.1000/182 resolves (HTTP 200) to the DOI Handbook landing; doi.org is the resolver designated by ISO 26324. The legacy dx.doi.org host is the DOI Handbook's documented alias form.

RFC Editor: https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc9110.html (HTTP 200) and the info page https://www.rfc-editor.org/info/rfc9110 (HTTP 200), which cites the DOI 10.17487/RFC9110; datatracker.ietf.org/doc/rfc9110/ (HTTP 200).
RFC Editor info pages carry the BCP sub-series: https://www.rfc-editor.org/info/bcp10 (HTTP 200); datatracker.ietf.org/doc/bcp10/ (HTTP 200).
RFC Editor info pages carry the STD sub-series: https://www.rfc-editor.org/info/std1 (HTTP 200); datatracker.ietf.org/doc/std1/ (HTTP 200).
RFC Editor info pages carry the FYI sub-series: https://www.rfc-editor.org/info/fyi4 (HTTP 200).

IETF Datatracker document pages: https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/draft-ietf-httpbis-messaging/ (HTTP 200) and the revision-specific https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/draft-ietf-httpbis-messaging/19/ (HTTP 200).

W3C technical-report 'latest version' pages: https://www.w3.org/TR/html40/, https://www.w3.org/TR/exi/ and https://www.w3.org/TR/css-backgrounds-3/ (HTTP 200 each); the dated companion form https://www.w3.org/TR/2009/CR-exi-20091208/ (HTTP 200).

EUR-Lex ELI URIs per Regulation (EU) No 182/2011 Annex II: https://eur-lex.europa.eu/eli/reg/2011/1227/oj, /eli/reg/2016/679/oj, /eli/dir/2004/38/oj, /eli/dec/2014/101/oj (all resolve, EUR-Lex serves HTTP 202); CELEX 32011R1227, 32016R0679, 32004L0038, 32014D0101 resolve in the legal-content form; the pubid-testsuite eu rows record the data.europa.eu/eli aliases as attested spellings.

arXiv abs pages carry the data DOI: https://arxiv.org/abs/0704.0001 cites DOI 10.48550/arXiv.0704.0001 and https://arxiv.org/abs/math.GT/0309136 cites DOI 10.48550/arXiv.math/0309136 (subject class dropped from the DOI id, kept in the abs id).
XMPP Extensions Editor: every XEP page is served at https://xmpp.org/extensions/xep-{number}.html (https://xmpp.org/extensions/xep-0004.html, HTTP 200).
The UN official document system resolves symbols: https://docs.un.org/en/A/RES/78/1 (HTTP 200).

IANA parameter-registry pages live at https://www.iana.org/assignments/{registry} (https://www.iana.org/assignments/_6lowpan-parameters, HTTP 200). The sub-registry facet has no reliably derivable page (value deep links 404 outside the self-nesting registries), so it is not mapped.
Ecma International standards landing pages: https://www.ecma-international.org/publications-and-standards/standards/ecma-262/ and /ecma-334/ (HTTP 200 each).
IHO publication pages key on the series designator: https://iho.int/en/s-4, /s-158, /s-411, /b-1, /b-12, /m-2, /p-5 (HTTP 200 each), one page per S/P/M/B/C series document.
